title: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A ghoulcaller who raises the dead by whistling and sings her creations back to life; she lives in the Engelturm and is Geralf's sister.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A stitcher and skaab-maker working in a laboratory in Havengul, and Gisa's brother; he is entrusted with Havengul's defense.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: Geralf's superior in Havengul, who tells Geralf about the Phyrexians and leaves him in charge of the city's defense while he visits a former student in Selhoff.

entities.name: Jadar
entities.description: An old-fashioned necromancer whom Geralf suggests Gisa bother instead of him.

entities.name: Jeleva
entities.description: An undead wizard who avoids Gisa and whom the local vampires fear.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Metallic invaders that bleed black oil and emerge from the Silburlind estuary and overland to attack Havengul and the Engelturm, in every shape from humans to transformed werewolves.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: A contagion carried by Phyrexian bodies that first affects the living mind and cannot infect the risen dead; it makes creatures stop caring about self-preservation.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The realm the invaders belong to, which seeks to turn Innistrad into an outpost on its road to empire.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane where Gisa and Geralf live, under attack by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Engelturm
entities.description: A former angel stronghold near Havengul, full of tools for dismantling the dead, where Gisa has settled.

entities.name: Havengul
entities.description: The sterile, industrial city where Geralf works and which the Phyrexians attack.

entities.name: Silburlind River
entities.description: The river and estuary beside Havengul from which the Phyrexians emerge and in which Gisa finds a huge buried beast.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city Gisa left behind, which had become boring once its living people were gone.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The region Gisa would return to if she lost the game.

entities.name: Selhoff
entities.description: A place where Ludevic visits a former student.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: The region whose seemingly inexhaustible dead Gisa draws on.

entities.name: NecroWarfare
entities.description: Geralf's game with rules, played by Gisa and Geralf, which they now use to frame their joint fight against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Gisa's undead moondrake
entities.description: An undead moondrake Gisa calls from the estuary muck, which kills a Phyrexian moondrake.

entities.name: Gisa's colossal sea-beast
entities.description: A giant crab-kraken-lobster horror raised by Gisa from the estuary bottom, later rebuilt by Geralf with the behemoth's legs.

entities.name: Geralf's behemoth
entities.description: A giant antlered skaab with pistons and a dead bear in its legs, built by Geralf and felled by the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf from the Engelturm, teasing him and mocking his skill as a ghoulcaller.
events.quote: What you do is no more than a pale imitation of my art

events.summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
events.quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

events.summary: Bored at the Engelturm, Gisa watches Phyrexians shamble out of the Silburlind River.
events.quote: A small group of bipedal figures shambled out of the Silburlind River

events.summary: A Phyrexian cuts one of Gisa's ghouls in two with an oil-slick sword, and Gisa sends her dead to attack them.
events.quote: All around her, the dead she had risen for her own amusement turned toward the cluster on the shore.

events.summary: Gisa's ghouls destroy the group, but a Phyrexian corpse she raises collapses lifeless the moment her attention wanders; this has never happened to her before.
events.quote: This had never happened to her before.

events.summary: Gisa complains to Geralf that he has ruined the undead.
events.quote: You have ruined the undead. Do not do this again.

events.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
events.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

events.summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
events.quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

events.summary: Gisa proposes a united game of NecroWarfare against Phyrexia, with Havengul or the Engelturm as the prize, and Geralf accepts.
events.quote: I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.

events.summary: Geralf sends his grotesque creations, including exploding winged turtles, to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.
events.quote: A wave of terrible creations swarmed over the walls of Havengul to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.

events.summary: Gisa draws in the death of Innistrad and calls a moondrake and ghouls from the estuary muck.
events.quote: the undead moondrake she had called from the muck rose, majestic, into the sky.

events.summary: A Phyrexian moondrake rises, and Gisa's moondrake kills it in the air and on the ground, spoiling a Phyrexian plan.
events.quote: her drake ripped the other's head clean off

events.summary: A second Phyrexian force approaches overland past the Engelturm, and Gisa complains it is cheating.
events.quote: "I said three-way, not four-way,"

events.summary: Geralf stitches skaabs at frantic speed in his hidden laboratory as Havengul falls, and his skaabs bring in a massive beast.
events.quote: a group of the skaabs he'd set to gathering raw materials entered, half-carrying and half-dragging a massive beast.

events.summary: Geralf's antlered behemoth steps over the city wall and tramples Phyrexians.
events.quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

events.summary: Not to be outdone, Gisa sings up a colossal chitinous beast from the bottom of the estuary, and it wades into the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Gisa's terrible new plaything rose from the bottom of the estuary

events.summary: The Phyrexians hack off the legs of Geralf's behemoth and then Gisa's sea-beast; both fall and Gisa stops laughing.
events.quote: Like the behemoth before it, it fell

events.summary: Geralf asks Gisa to give up her broken sea-beast so his skaabs can retrieve both monsters, and Gisa, after a tantrum, agrees on condition he owes her.
events.quote: If your creations can drag it back to your lab, I'll let it go. But you'll owe me!

events.summary: Geralf stitches the behemoth and sea-beast together in a city square, believing it will be his masterpiece.
events.quote: Grabbing the drill he would need to create seams through the beast's chitinous armor, he grinned to himself and set to work.

events.summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
events.quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

events.summary: The siblings burn dead Phyrexians in a bonfire and bicker over who won the game; Geralf notes the fused beast has collapsed.
events.quote: "Neither of us won," Gisa snapped.

relations.quote: Even her own brother, dear, disgusting Geralf

relations.note: Geralf researches and defends Havengul for Ludevic
relations.quote: Ludevic has given me the great honor of researching this phenomenon
I propose NecroWarfare, us united against Phyrexia, winner take all.
fought brilliantly and hard, but in the end, they were outnumbered by a factor of dozens.
he has elected to trust me with the defense of Havengul

relations.note: Gisa has settled in the former angel stronghold
relations.quote: How I wish you would visit me here in Engelturm!
I am not regretting the choice to tell you my lab was too small for the both of us

relations.note: Gisa raised it from the estuary bottom
relations.quote: Gisa's terrible new plaything rose from the bottom of the estuary

relations.note: Geralf's skaabs brought the beast to his lab
relations.quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

relations.note: Jeleva avoids Gisa for fear her mind would be damaged
relations.quote: None of the local vampires bothered her, out of fear of Jeleva
